description: THE SIX INVESTIGATION ACTS ARE BUILT AS FAR AS THE ARCHITECTURE PERMITS WITHOUT A RULING, AND THE RULING REQUEST IS THE REST OF THIS ROW. Jordan, 2026-09-10: "'the six investigation acts' is a massive issue: that is not a verb", and "you must ensure you build the six from investigation systems". BUILT: verb_table.yaml's single row "the six investigation acts" (requires: 'per act', requires_typed: none, grade: assumption) is replaced by the six acts canon names at investigation_systems_v30.md:217 -- examine, interview, research, surveil, thread_read, reconstruct -- each with a typed requires built from the EXISTING closed grammar (no new requires_form, no new requires_operand, no new predicate stem). MEASURED: verbs 32 -> 37, resolvable 12 -> 17, EXECUTING IN THE CORPUS 6 -> 10; distinct corpus behaviours 2 -> 16; SS F1 clause-4 drops 25 (all `move`) -> 1,491 across six verbs -- both sides measured by ONE script over the same 89 worlds at DEFAULT_FIXTURES, run at d59c3e1 in a worktree and again on the commit; the first writing of this row said 13, quoted from a test docstring rather than measured, which put a quoted number and a measured one in one ratio (SS0.1 pt 4), and under which `move` itself FELL 25 -> 18 rather than rising as the quoted figure had it. The tree holds two further unreconciled figures for this quantity: that docstring's 13 (86 worlds, an earlier instrument) and wd_extra.corpus_drops' 0 at the shipped cell. This closes the producer hole W-D's own diagnosis named ("clause 4 has exactly ONE reachable instance in the corpus; that is a producer hole and is where the work goes") and recovers W-D's acceptance at the shipped arm, 0 of 16 forks -> 14 of 18. Two corpus cases lost a blocker (NPC-086 BLOCKED -> DEGRADED; NPC-010 lost one of three). NOT BUILT, AND THIS IS THE RULING REQUEST -- FOUR QUESTIONS THAT ARE ONE QUESTION. (1) WHAT IS INVESTIGATION'S SEAM? rosters.yaml:481 types it 'UNRULED | UNRULED | UNRULED -- ITS OWN KIND, not a contest', and :487-491 rules that writing a plausible IN/OUT for an unruled mode 'would be inventing the architecture rather than recording it, and the seam is precisely the thing that must not be invented'. Without it nothing resolves a DEGREE, so the six ship with a flat `emits:` while fieldwork_v30.md:302-309 grades every one of them on four bands (Failure's false lead, Partial's incomplete detail, Success's reliable one, Overwhelming's bonus revelation). rosters.yaml:505-508 forbids the near escape of giving them a prize so the contest machinery can grade them ('scripting drift'). (2) WHAT SUPPLIES THE POOL, AND MAY IT GATE? fieldwork_v30.md:57 makes the pool (Primary Attribute x 2) + History bonus, and Person.capability is the field #353 SS9.2 says 'supplies dice and GATES NOTHING' -- declared, EMPTY on every corpus person, and a RETIRED write-matrix row. READING it for a pool looks lawful; GATING on it is refused by name in four places (verbs.py's eligibility check, options.py's person_side_eligible, probes.py's P11 'capability gates no verb', and SS9.2's own warning against re-implementing 'a gate the design deleted on purpose'). ⚠ AND CANON CONTRADICTS CANON HERE, WHICH IS WHY IT IS A JORDAN QUESTION RATHER THAN A CALL: fieldwork_v30.md:76 says attribute gates ARE hard -- 'Characters below the gate cannot attempt the action' -- in as many words. Two ratified documents, opposite answers. (3) WHAT SUPPLIES THE OBSTACLE? fieldwork_v30.md:29-38 gives base Ob by DEPTH, and depth is a property of the content dug for, not of the digger -- so it has no producer in this loop. SS27.4 separately forbids routing an uncontested attempt to an Ob = 0 roll. Reconstruct is the one act whose Ob canon derives (threshold - progress, min 1, :298) and its threshold is chosen at investigation opening BY A GM (:260-264), a role this engine does not have; Question carries no scope field to read one off. (4) WHERE DO EXPOSURE AND CO-MOVEMENT LAND? Surveil costs +2 Exposure and Thread-Read +1 plus a Coherence cost and P-01 co-movement (SS4.2, SS4.5). Exposure is tracked per territory (:261) and 04:237 forbids ANY social aggregate on a Rung -- 'no norms, unrest, legitimacy, reputation, discipline'. So the one canon effect these two acts have besides the finding has no carrier at all. Nothing is written for it and nothing is invented elsewhere. WHY THIS SURVIVES CLAUDE.md SS0's FIVE TESTS: (1) not superseded -- rosters.yaml's seam table is current and ED-IN-0211 (filed as ED-IN-0208, then ED-IN-0210; renumbered twice on merge) is open; (2) not irrelevant -- the acts are built and running now; (3) not answered by a design document -- fieldwork_v30.md:76 and #353 SS9.2 answer (2) in opposite directions; (4) not answered by precedent -- the three contest subsystems' precedent is exactly what rosters.yaml:505-508 forbids applying here; (5) not an obvious engineering call -- SS27.4 blocks the Ob = 0 roll, the operand roster is closed pending H-94's ruling, and the seam table says writing an IN/OUT is inventing the architecture. ALSO IN THIS COMMIT, and not part of the ruling: verbs.py's loader invariant 12 was ONE-SIDED -- it checked `writes:` for a degree source and never `emits:`, so a row with a flat `writes:` (the six's shape), a degree-keyed `emits:` and no `contests:` LOADED CLEAN and raised mid-corpus at the first fold. Both directions are checked now, with a falsifier (test_invariant_12_refuses_a_degree_keyed_emits_with_nothing_to_key_it_on). And the six landed conviction-inert -- alignment's sparse default is 0.0 -- which was measured to DISPLACE `tell` by the name tiebreak; weighted cells with reasons replaced the alphabet under H-66. ===== RETRACTION, 2026-09-10, SAME DAY: THE ESCALATION DOES NOT SURVIVE SS0's FIVE TESTS AND needs_jordan IS WITHDRAWN. All four questions are answered inside the tree, and an adversarial pass on the delivered work found the first two. CLAUDE.md SS0: 'needs_jordan means Jordan is the only person who can answer this, not nobody got around to it.' (1) THE SEAM -- CLOSED AT TEST 3/4. workplans/2026-09-06-season-loop-execution-plan.md:647 ran this exact blank through the same five tests four days earlier and closed it: 'investigation / detective / IF | acted, ITS OWN KIND -- not a contest | RESOLVE -> WITNESS | investigator, subject, degree | Claims graded by degree; Failure emits finding.none and deposits nothing | NOT A SEAM. The loop IS the mechanism -- closes at test 3 ... | 4.5', under a heading that reads 'THREE OF THE FOUR BLANKS ARE NOT SEAMS AT ALL ... investigation [is] the loop itself'. So there is no seam to rule; there is work item 4.5. The six rows shipped here already implement that row's refusal half verbatim -- emits_on_refusal: ['finding.none'] -- and what is missing is only the degree producer, which is 4.5's content and not a design call. I cited rosters.yaml's seam table and did not search for who else had cited it. (2) 'CANON CONTRADICTS CANON' ON THE ATTRIBUTE GATE -- WITHDRAWN AS AN EQUIVOCATION. I set fieldwork_v30.md:76 against #353 SS9.2 as two ratified documents giving opposite answers. Read in place, :76 is the 'Perception gates' paragraph and governs DEPTH ACCESS, not verb availability: its worked examples are the Depth-1 and Depth-2 gates from the table at :34-35, and :33 gives Depth 0 the gate 'None'. Canon does not say a low-Cognition character cannot Examine; it says they cannot reach Hidden content by examining. SS9.2 forbids gating a VERB on capability. The two are compatible. What actually blocks the pool is engineering and is named elsewhere: capability is empty on every corpus person (W27's cast) and the loop has no Depth carrier to hang the real gate on. SS0 test 5. (3) THE OBSTACLE -- follows (1). The degree producer is item 4.5; the GM-set Evidence-Track threshold (3/5/8 at :262-266) is answered by the engine's own premise -- CLAUDE.md: 'There is no GM -- the engine resolves everything' -- so the scope is derived, not asked for. Engineering. (4) EXPOSURE -- ANSWERED AT TEST 4 BY PRECEDENT, AND 04:237 IS NOT THE BLOCKER I READ IT AS. architecture/meta/01_AXIOMS.md:1001-1002, verbatim: 'secrecy needs no representation at all, because under AX-2 a claim nobody witnessed is simply unknown and secrecy is the EMPTY OBSERVER SET.' Conspicuousness is the same quantity with the sign reversed: it is the SIZE of the observer set, which WITNESS already computes per Event from presence and the five channels. So 04:237's ban on a social aggregate on a Rung is not an obstruction -- it is the reason a per-territory meter was the wrong shape to begin with. That axiom also names its own live attack (a claim concealable from a witness who WAS present would force a real field), which is a caveat on the answer, not a reason to escalate. WHAT REMAINS IS WORK, NOT A RULING, and it is item 4.5: a degree producer for investigation, at RESOLVE -> WITNESS, whose OUT is Claims graded by degree. Its own blockers are the two named above -- no attribute values on any person (W27) and no Depth carrier -- plus SS27.4's refusal to route an uncontested attempt to an Ob = 0 roll. ===== AND TWO PUBLISHED NUMBERS IN THIS ROW ARE CORRECTED BY THE SAME PASS. (a) The clause-4 headline of 1,491 includes 387 drops on `restore`, which is NOT in resolvable_verbs() -- it writes Site.condition with no EFFECTS entry, and choose.py applies the verbs= filter AFTER opening_set returns -- so those drops cannot move a decision. The decision-affecting figure is 1,104 across FIVE verbs. (b) Measured, examine and restore fire on the IDENTICAL EIGHT SUBJECTS: their cells are the same shape (existence of a Site plus present_at), so that is one belief counted twice, not two findings. The sentence 'one person's failed look teaches them not to try to mend the thing' is WITHDRAWN -- the belief forms and nothing acts on it. What survives is 25 -> 1,104, and predicates driving clause 4 going from ONE (contain.path) to FIVE.
source: Jordan, 2026-09-10, two rulings in session. Built and measured against the working tree: `python -m pytest engine/season/tests -q`; `python -m engine.season.harness.corpus_run`; `python -m engine.season.harness.register --requirements`. The reduced scope is the product of an agonist->antagonist relay -- a read-only critic (.claude/agents/valoria-critic.md) overturned the first carve's seam, obstacle column, attribute gate and depth derivation against rosters.yaml:481/:487-491/:505-508, #353 SS9.2 and SS27.4, and every overturn was re-verified at source before the carve was cut back to what needs no ruling.
